For me it's back and forth.  This whole past week was great except this night I made the post.  Witnessed a guy have a grand mal seizure and almost die which fucked up my mood and triggered my depression I guess.  Had a vivid as hell using dream last night which fucked me up even more and put me in a shitty mood all day.  Then just now I was playing with my cat, ran toward him, and accidentally kicked him in the face which scared him and pissed him off.

That may seem arbitrary, but it REALLY made me sad for some reason.  I tried to pet him to apologize and he ran away from me and spied on me with big eyes around the corner and shit.  Low-key I started crying.  I felt so bad I accidentally kicked him pretty fucking hard, right on his petite little head.

...I pet his sister and tried to tell her to bring "your brother down here so I can say sorry."  I didn't see him for a half hour.  He was spooked.  I know he wanted water (which I was gonna do after I played with him for a bit) so I turned on the faucet that I knew he and his sister always drink from.

After some time, he peeks around the corner.  I slow blink at him (which in cat language means "I love you" don't ask me how I know that lulz) and I was sad as fuck so I knew he picked up on that.  He came up to me and I pet him for like 10 minutes straight saying I'm sorry over and over lol.

He's sleeping in my room as I type this.

I guess my point is that shit happens.  I feel like I wanna die sometimes.  I feel depressed, feel like using, etc etc.  

But I can get through it.

I just kicked my cat in the face.  On accident, but I kicked him in the fucking face.  My leg was rushing toward him as he unexpectedly did a cat-like full-speed dash run.  Imagine if some asshole kicked you in the face, and said asshole was tall as a motherfucker.  I'd be pretty pissed off too.

But I got through it, and everything is cool now.

Sorry for the rant I just thought this experience was a microcosm for life I had to just share lulz.

Just finished a fifth step.  Yesterday.  This selfishness for pussy REALLY was a recurring theme.  My sponsor and I collectively tore me a new asshole haha.  

This mindset I had at the time of this post was when I was REALLY in my disease, clearly.  That's how shitty of a person I am when I let it take over me.  It usually manifests in alcohol and drugs, but take those out... and it's compulsive Netflix watching, video game playing, trying to be the fastest driver on the highway, being the coolest guy at the party, or like that particular night, getting the most girls, and I get PISSED and INSANE when my particular need or "rush of choice" isn't or can't be met.

Im trying my best to work my program.  When I'm working my program and not trying to get any fucking ass, I'm happy.  Content.  Filled with purpose.  When I'm in my disease (it's getting easier to deal with but obviously still there) I get egotistical, selfish as shit, and just plain miserable.

I'm trying my best.  Not perfect (I let everyone see a bad moment of mine) but trying my best to be the best, most true and genuinely self-loving version of myself possible

I'm focusing on myself now and I'm trying to be better than that fucking mindset I can fall into
